name: ES vs CL Intraday Correlation — US/EU Overlap Session
description: 5-minute rolling correlation between ES (S&P 500 E-Mini) and CL (WTI Crude Oil) returns, filtered to the 08:00–11:00 ET session window (US/EU overlap). Uses a 60-bar rolling Pearson correlation of close-to-close returns. Outputs: (1) rolling correlation line chart with threshold reference lines at 0, 0.3, and 0.5; (2) summary stats table with avg correlation, min, max, % of bars above 0.3, % above 0.5, and all-history std dev of the correlation series.
source:
# ES vs CL Intraday Correlation — US/EU Overlap Session
# 5-min bars | 08:00–11:00 ET session | 60-bar rolling Pearson correlation of returns
# Answers: How tightly do ES and CL move together during the US/EU overlap?

# ============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ============================================================================

# Primary: ES (S&P 500 E-Mini futures)
src_es = market_data_source()()
cont_es = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(src_es.o, src_es.h, src_es.l, src_es.c, src_es.v, src_es.oi, src_es.s)

# Reference: CL (WTI Crude Oil futures) — needs continuation to avoid multi-contract rows
cl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='CL')()
cont_cl = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(cl_raw.o, cl_raw.h, cl_raw.l, cl_raw.c, cl_raw.v, cl_raw.oi, cl_raw.s)

# ============================================================================
# SESSION WINDOW — 08:00–11:00 ET (US/EU overlap)
# ============================================================================

session_es = session_window(
    session=Session(start='08:00', end='11:00', tz='America/New_York')
)(cont_es.o, cont_es.h, cont_es.l, cont_es.c)

session_cl = session_window(
    session=Session(start='08:00', end='11:00', tz='America/New_York')
)(cont_cl.o, cont_cl.h, cont_cl.l, cont_cl.c)

# ============================================================================
# RETURNS — close-to-close on 5-min bars, masked to session window
# ============================================================================

# Compute returns on all bars, then mask to session-active bars only
es_ret_raw = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.simple)(cont_es.c)
cl_ret_raw = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.simple)(cont_cl.c)

# Mask: NaN outside the 08:00–11:00 session
es_ret = where(session_es.active, es_ret_raw)
cl_ret = where(session_cl.active, cl_ret_raw)

# ============================================================================
# ROLLING CORRELATION — 60-bar Pearson on session-filtered returns
# ============================================================================

corr_60 = rolling_corr(
    window=60,
    window_type=WindowType.rolling,
    method=CorrelationMethod.pearson
)(x=es_ret, y=cl_ret)

# Mask correlation output to session bars only (NaN outside session)
corr_session = where(session_es.active, corr_60)

# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY STATISTICS
# ============================================================================

# % of session bars where correlation > 0.3 (hit rate as 0-1 decimal for PercentFormat)
above_03 = 1.0 if (is_valid(corr_session) and corr_session > 0.3) else 0.0
above_05 = 1.0 if (is_valid(corr_session) and corr_session > 0.5) else 0.0

# All-history (expanding) std dev of the correlation — measures stability over full period
corr_std_expanding = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Std)(corr_session)

# ============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Rolling Correlation Line Chart
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Do ES and CL Move Together During the US/EU Overlap?',
    category='ES vs CL Correlation',
    order=1,
    y_axis_label='Rolling 60-Bar Correlation',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60-Bar Rolling Corr (08:00–11:00 ET)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.3, title='Moderate (0.3)', color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, title='Strong (0.5)', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=0.3, to=0.5, color=Color.Amber, opacity=0.07, label='Moderate'),
        PlotBand(from=0.5, to=1.0, color=Color.Orange, opacity=0.07, label='Strong')
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=corr_session)

# ============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Summary Stats Table
# ============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ES vs CL Correlation Stats — 08:00–11:00 ET Session',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Central Tendency', 'Regime Frequency'],
        col_headers=['Avg Corr', 'Min', 'Max'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: Central tendency stats
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3,
                       info='Mean rolling correlation across all session bars'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3,
                       info='Minimum rolling correlation observed'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3,
                       info='Maximum rolling correlation observed'),
            # Row 1: Regime frequency (% above thresholds) — reuse corr_session for std dev slot
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3,
                       info='All-history std dev of rolling correlation (stability measure)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       info='% of session bars with correlation above 0.3 (moderate co-movement)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       info='% of session bars with correlation above 0.5 (strong co-movement)')
        ]
    ),
    category='ES vs CL Correlation',
    order=0
)(corr_session, corr_session, corr_session, corr_std_expanding, above_03, above_05)
